# Issue 5 : Find the correlation with US Karen data and the other three countries in the future 60 years. (assume only female Karens)

# Package
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```


# Read in Data 
```{r}
data <- read.csv(here("full-names-data-nice.csv"))
```


#Find Corr 
```{r}
helperCorLagOther(data %>% filter(country == "US" & 
                                    Name == "Karen" & 
                                    Sex == "Girl"), 
                  60, 
                  data %>% filter(Name == "Karen" & 
                                    Sex == "Girl")) 


helperCorLagKaren(data %>% filter(country == "US" & 
                                    Name == "Karen" & 
                                    Sex == "Girl"), 
                  60, 
                  data %>% filter(Name == "Karen" & 
                                    Sex == "Girl")) 

```
